literal: Indeed excess practiced nature-of-action becomes even distinction itself, excellence with-those-who-lack if-obtained.
translation: If high status and distinction are acquired by those who lack excellent qualities, it will only result in actions of sheer arrogance and excess.
modern: சிறந்த பண்புகள் இல்லாதவர்களிடம் உயர்வோ சிறப்போ வந்து சேர்ந்தால், அது வரம்பு மீறிய செயல்களைச் செய்யும் தன்மையுடையதாகவே மாறும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how power or high status affects people of different characters. The word 'சீர்' refers to excellent qualities or merit, and 'அல்லவர்' refers to those who lack them. When 'சிறப்பு' (distinction, wealth, or high status) reaches such unworthy people, it does not make them noble. Instead, it manifests as 'இறப்பு' (excessiveness or arrogance) in their actions ('தொழிற்று'). The poet warns that giving power to those without character only leads to the transgression of limits and harmful behavior.
